method: Sixteen balanced pairs per workload on one background thread. After two unscored waves, each measured invocation runs 64 waves. Sixteen already bulk-classified streams each offer 64 KiB once per wave. The mixed workload adds a 17-byte reply on a previously bulk flow and one byte on an unclassified stream. Wall throughput includes offering, relay and verification. CPU counts the relay callback. Marker time starts at callback entry and ends after the successful write. Bootstrap resamples full paired invocations. This is a host socketpair service-order experiment, excluding TCP connection setup and the VM.
